slides.headline: What is low doc lending?
slides.body: Low doc lending replaces full financial statements with reduced paperwork — typically recent bank statements, BAS lodgements or an accountant's declaration. It still requires evidence of income; it simply accepts different forms of it. This can suit self-employed borrowers whose income doesn't fit a standard employed-income template.

caption:
Low doc doesn't mean no doc — it means a different kind of evidence.

Instead of full accountant-prepared financials, lenders may accept recent bank statements, BAS lodgements or an accountant's declaration of income. It's built for self-employed borrowers, sole traders and newer businesses whose income is real but doesn't fit a standard employed-income template.

Not sure if your income evidence fits? Let's find out together.

General information only. This does not constitute financial, legal, accounting or tax advice. Credit is subject to lender assessment, eligibility and approval criteria. Fees, charges, terms and conditions may apply.
